hims-violet.$description: Hims Violet — Headline text, display borders, brand accent — the single chromatic voice in an otherwise monochrome system

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, hairline borders, icon fills, nav dividers — the structural ink of the interface

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, nav background, image backgrounds — the base surface at every elevation level

vellum-gray.$description: Vellum Gray — List dividers, subtle row separators, muted list text — the quietest structural neutral

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary heading text, heading borders — slightly softer than pure black for non-display headings

linen.$description: Linen — Hairline borders, list separators, thin structural strokes

stone.$description: Stone — Muted body copy, subdued links, secondary metadata text

soft-mint.$description: Soft Mint — Decorative product accent — appears inside app screenshot tiles (e.g. Acne Program card), not a UI token

iris.$description: Iris — Decorative product accent — appears in product gradient washes inside phone mockup content

sofia.$description: Sofia is the sole typeface. Its geometric, low-contrast letterforms carry everything from 14px nav labels to 280px display heroes. Weight 400 is the default at all sizes; weight 500 is reserved for emphasis. The extreme size range (14→280px) with consistent tight tracking (-0.012em to -0.057em) creates a system that scales smoothly from caption to billboard. Signature choice: the ultra-tight tracking even at body sizes (-0.012em at 14px) gives body text a compressed, editorial density unusual for a consumer health app.
